d: You have extensive experience in luxury retail management, with a strong track record in driving business performance, developing teams and implementing successful retail strategies.

You are a strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen, excellent leadership skills and the ability to navigate complex business environments. You naturally build strong relationships with stakeholders and inspire teams to achieve excellence.

Analytical, proactive and results-oriented, you combine a client-centric mindset with a genuine passion for luxury retail. Your ability to drive change, foster collaboration and develop talent will be key to succeeding in this role.
What are we expecting from you?
As Market Retail Director, you will define and implement the retail strategy across the Market, in alignment with the Maison’s vision and business objectives.

Working closely with the Managing Director, Regional and International teams, you will drive business performance, ensure operational excellence and lead the development of retail teams while delivering an exceptional client experience.
r: Defining and implementing the Market retail strategy to drive sales, profitability and sustainable business growth.
Monitoring business performance through key retail KPIs, identifying opportunities and implementing action plans to enhance boutique performance.
Leading, coaching and developing Boutique Managers and retail teams, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Partnering with HR to anticipate talent needs, support recruitment, succession planning and team development across the retail network.
Overseeing boutique operations and ensuring compliance with Maison standards, policies and operational procedures.
Collaborating with Retail Operations, Marketing, Client Experience, Finance and other cross-functional teams to support business priorities and commercial initiatives.
Driving the implementation of regional and international retail initiatives, ensuring alignment with local market needs and business objectives.
Identifying business opportunities, monitoring market trends and competition, and providing strategic insights to Regional and International teams.
Leading boutique development projects, including new openings, network optimization and the maintenance of high retail standards.
Defining and implementing High Jewelry client development strategies, supporting VIP client relationships and identifying opportunities to strengthen the Maison’s client portfolio.
Supporting the development of High Jewelry expertise within retail teams through coaching, training and talent identification.
Acting as an ambassador of the Maison, nurturing relationships with key clients and partners while supporting exclusive client events and commercial opportunities.
More than a role… We recruit for a career!
By joining Van Cleef & Arpels, you will become part of a Maison where excellence, creativity and people development are at the heart of everything we do.

From your first day, you will be supported through comprehensive onboarding and continuous learning opportunities designed to help you grow your expertise and build a long-term career within the Maison and the Richemont Group.

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application, and should your profile match our requirements, you will be invited to meet with the recruiter. You will then have the opportunity to meet with the Hiring Manager and relevant business stakeholders throughout the recruitment journey.

To support the deployment, management, and maintenance of the organization's cloud (AWS) and on-premises IT infrastructure. This role focuses on ensuring system availability, assisting with cloud resource provisioning, monitoring infrastructure health, and resolving routine technical issues while growing specialized expertise in cloud architecture and IT operations.
Cloud Administration: Assist in provisioning, configuring, and managing core AWS services (including EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, and IAM) under the guidance of senior engineers.
System Monitoring: Monitor cloud resource utilization, infrastructure health, and application performance using AWS CloudWatch and internal monitoring tools to ensure high availability.
Infrastructure Support: Provide day-to-day administration and troubleshooting for on-premises IT infrastructure, including physical servers, virtual machines, and basic network configurations.
Security & Compliance: Support the implementation of security best practices by managing IAM permissions, configuring security groups, and assisting with routine system patching and updates.
Automation & Scripting: Help automate repetitive operational tasks and routine deployments using basic scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
Incident Resolution: Respond to and troubleshoot Level 1 and Level 2 IT infrastructure and cloud-related support tickets, escalating complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Documentation: Create and maintain up-to-date documentation for infrastructure configurations, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational runbooks.
Perform any other related tasks as requested.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cloud Computing, System Engineering, or a relevant discipline. Specialized Education/Certifications:
Highly Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate.
Nice to have: CompTIA Network+, Security+, or basic ITIL
Work Experience: 0 to 2 years of professional experience in IT operations, helpdesk support, systems administration, or cloud infrastructure. Relevant Work Experience:
Demonstrable hands-on experience working within the AWS console (internships, academic capstones, and personal portfolio labs are acceptable for entry-level candidates).
Experience troubleshooting Linux and Windows server environments.
Exposure to basic networking tasks and troubleshooting.

We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all. If you have a disability or long-term condition (for example dyslexia, anxiety, autism, a mobility condition or are deaf) and need us to make any adjustments, changes or do anything differently during the recruitment process, please let us know through the application form.
AWS Core Services: Foundational understanding of AWS compute, storage, database, and network services.
Operating Systems: Basic command-line proficiency and administration knowledge in Linux (e.g., Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) and Windows Server environments.
Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of core networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and basic subnetting.
Scripting: Ability to read and write basic scripts in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate simple tasks.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Introductory knowledge or conceptual understanding of IaC tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation is a strong advantage.

Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, a strong eagerness to learn, and the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
